minutes.headline: Committee tabled the line-item transfer, contract ratification and capital priorities; passed a batch of non-discrimination policies.
minutes.summary: The committee met, went into executive session on non-union negotiations, then took public comment, minutes, and a superintendent report that included the finance director's resignation and a freeze on the current-year budget. It heard an assessment report, read non-discrimination and harassment policies and moved a batch (excluding one with a copy error), and tabled the line-item transfer, contract ratification and capital planning priorities to the next meeting.

what_happened.line: The committee tabled the line-item transfer, which was prepared ahead of cafeteria and custodian contracts, until those contracts are approved.
Contract ratification was tabled until November 1st; the minutes record the motion but the outcome was not audible.
The superintendent reported the finance director's resignation and a freeze on the current-year budget until a new finance director is in place.
The committee moved a batch of non-discrimination policies, excluding policy 5218, and a waiver of the second read of 6214; outcomes were not audible.
Discussion of capital planning priorities was tabled, and members were asked to send their priority lists to the superintendent.

why_it_matters: The current-year school budget is frozen while the finance director's post turns over, and the transfer for cafeteria and custodian contracts waits on those contracts, so school spending decisions are on hold until they are settled.

Capital priorities, including the track field assessment money from federal relief funds that has not been spent, were tabled and are competing with town-wide capital needs that a member described as large, so residents may be asked to vote on school-related warrant articles later.
watch_next: The November 1st agenda, where contract ratification is expected and the line-item transfer is due to return.
The next meeting's agenda, which is to include school-related warrant articles, capital priorities and a third read of a policy.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the main votes (line item transfer tabled, PTO donations accepted, policy 6214 second read waived) and on the freeze and $250,000 stabilization figures. They differ on the contract ratification (a Nov 1 tabling versus a postponed negotiation), the capital priority list process, the policy vote's contents, and who attended.
